native_paths.http: The native Legal register/detail/export and command routers are mounted in the private API; the Legal workspace and record routes use the native transport for the registered workflows.
native_paths.ssr: The Legal workspace register, detail, holds, document access, contract approval and archive journeys use the native owner HTTP paths. The native enrollment/verification path is mounted for the portal.
native_paths.jobs: legalWork invokes the durable native Legal document worker for OCR/PDF; the native worker has --once/--loop runtime modes, provider probes, schema/binding checks and bounded schedule/backoff.
native_paths.providers: Native OCR/DOCX extraction and offline PDF verification (erpx-verify-pdf + erpx-validate-pdf) pass the actual provider gate. AI generation, official law-source fetching and invitation email remain external provider consumers, not Legal-native provider ports.
native_paths.enrollment: POST /api/v1/account/legal-enrollment verifies the erpx-legal-enrollment JWT and Legal share, creates the Argon2id/local:credential account, and hands the verification token to the existing sandbox email adapter. The invited unverified continuation returns 403.

legacy.primary: The registered Legal workflows use native owner HTTP/SSR and the native document worker; the TypeScript legal identity/branding/document writers used by these workflows are retired from the runtime path.
legacy.secondary: Auxiliary Legal views (knowledge, law corpus, reports, governance, executed-copy listing, assignees, retention/trust/features tabs) still execute retained TypeScript application reads. They are outside the five registered workflows; named removal condition: migrate each auxiliary view to its owner HTTP port when that capability enters the registered scope.
legacy.enrollment: The Legal enroll route no longer calls createAuth sign-up; it uses the native enrollment endpoint and the existing sandbox email adapter for the verification link.

fixes: Added AccountCredentials.sign_up_legal and the Postgres repository path with native Argon2id and issuer=local:credential.
Added the Legal share-token validated POST /api/v1/account/legal-enrollment private endpoint and the native SDK path.
Switched the Legal enroll route to the native endpoint and the sandbox verification email.
Fixed the native verify/get-session test handoff by filtering cleared cookies and stopping the native test server before disposable database cleanup.
notes: Legal is owner 5/41 in this record. The five registered workflows are verified with native/frontend/gates/browser evidence; the auxiliary TS views are recorded as named remaining consumers, not used by the registered workflows.
No production, staging, deployment, schema deletion or destructive cleanup was performed.
